subject.title: fix(bedrock): avoid replaying partial thinking signatures

question: Must this PR show a real AWS Bedrock interrupted stream followed by a successful persisted replay before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override that proof requirement?
rationale: The patch changes replay-critical provider state, while all supplied behavioral evidence replaces the real AWS client and event stream; policy requires human intent before accepting that gap.

options.title: Require live replay proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Bedrock evidence showing interruption, persisted output without a partial signature, and a successful subsequent turn before merge.

options.title: Explicit proof override
options.body: Accept the mocked production-path transcript as sufficient for this narrow prevention change while keeping the broader linked issue open.

recommendation.title: Require live replay proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Bedrock evidence showing interruption, persisted output without a partial signature, and a successful subsequent turn before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current replay sanitization and recovery behavior appears to date to commit 791ad08, making its introducer the strongest available owner for proof sufficiency across prevention and recovery.
